architecture_scope: Preserve the first causal route, survival, combat, and diagnosis transition for every raid or dungeon watchdog run. Do not encode Magmaw-specific strategy in the evidence contract.

first_broken_edge.cause: The retained heartbeat ledger contains changing counters and hashes but omits the compact route, survival, combat, and per-bot diagnosis state needed to attribute the ten-death and recovery transition.

next_action: Add and test one compact, bounded heartbeat causal receipt. It must expose route scope, alive count, death and wipe state, recovery generation, boss health or originated damage, party DPS and HPS, and per-bot diagnosis codes without retaining duplicate raw payloads. No gameplay mutation or live retry is admitted by this unit.

documentation and skill guidance for consuming the compact receipt
